messages.author: aca764e4496a9912
messages.subject: Error running deployApp() (Error in task$task_id)
parts:
Hello guys!

I have an issue related with Shiny App deploying. Here's my problem.

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 19440...
Error in task$task_id : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

Some details that might be useful:

1) my app is running just fine at local;
2) I have to set options(shinyapps.service_url = "http://api.shinyapps.io/v1") to be able to set my account info (setAccountInfo()) - maybe due firewall issues.
3) There are two folders with dependencies stuff, like data and statics.

The thing is: I do not have any "task" list or data.frame on my code. So, I'm stuck!
Anything else that I need to provide, please insist.

Please, help me.

Thanks!

PS: I apologize for any "bad impressions" caused by my poor skilled English speaking. I am pretty glad for all the work that you guys from RStudio do.
